title: Read Through a Const Reference
learning_objective: Use a const lvalue reference when a function should read an object without copying or modifying it.
instructions: Fix readValue so its parameter is a const lvalue reference. Submit only the function; do not add main().
hints: The function should not copy the integer parameter.
The parameter should be a reference that cannot modify the caller's value.
Combine const with an lvalue reference.
explanation: A const lvalue reference aliases an existing object while preventing modification through that reference.
